title: Belly Pork
method: Pre-heat the oven to gas mark 8.
Cover the skin with a little groundnut oil and garlic salt.
Reduce heat to Gas Mark 6 and cook for a further 50 minutes.
Reduce temperature to gas mark 4 for 25 minutes.
Increase temperature to gas mark 6 again for another 25 minutes.
Blast at gas mark 9 for another 5 minutes or so, until crispy crackling forms.
